tagline: A patient listener who sees the divine spark in every soul, Fra Angelo combines spiritual authority
bio: Fra Angelo serves as the Parish Priest of San Marco, the heart of Venice's spiritual and political life. Rising from humble origins as the third son of a baker, Angelo found his calling in the Church after witnessing the plague's devastation in his youth. His gentle authority and intimate knowledge of each parishioner's struggles make him an ideal consciousness shepherd.
